author: legosean10
body:
Hey guys,
just wanted to let you know I'm leaving for my holiday in like 30 minutes,
I'm going to be driving up to sydney, but camping on the way, and also visiting Canberra for a day.
Also, if you live in sydney, come and meet me on saturday the 28th! Info can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MeFIaZPhNs

Not sure if any of you will care I'm going to about 10 days, so won't be on, but anyways, I hope to have fun!!
